translations.web: Rise up, you judge of the earth. Pay back the proud what they deserve.
translations.bsb: Rise up, O Judge of the earth; render a reward to the proud.
translations.kjv: Lift up thyself, thou judge of the earth: render a reward to the proud.
translations.asv: Lift up thyself, thou judge of the earth: Render to the proud their desert.
